content:
Orient the prism with base \(5\times 12\) and height \(3\). The vertical cut along a diagonal of the \(5\times 12\) base creates two congruent triangular prisms with right triangular bases of legs \(5\) and \(12\), and prism height \(3\).

For one triangular prism:

- Triangular base area: \(\frac12(5)(12)=30\)
- Two triangular bases: \(2(30)=60\)
- Hypotenuse of triangular base: \(\sqrt{5^2+12^2}=13\)
- Lateral surface area: \((5+12+13)(3)=90\)

Total surface area:
\[
60+90=150
\]

\[
\boxed{150}
\]
